list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden; as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed it, 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own. Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, and names its source beside it.

sources.egamers: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies
sources.howto: HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
sources.keengamer: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
sources.list: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades and counts)
sources.pushsquare: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (WIP)
sources.shacknews: Shacknews — GTA 6 100% Completion checklist (source: Rockstar Games)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Budget roughly 200 hours for the full run, most of it after the story on the 100% completion checklist. Sources: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); Push Square puts the platinum at up to 300 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Push Square

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — Jason's first mission — and finish it. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); Push Square's story walkthrough.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Push Square

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 1 and the chapter trophy pops. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house — it is the one spot tied to the possibly missable Positive Mental Attitude trophy. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); KeenGamer on the Chapter 1 meditation.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2's story missions to the end. Like every chapter trophy it unlocks automatically on completion, so just keep following the story. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's story missions. This is the Vice City chapter, so use the time in the city to start the collectible and activity trophies that are available there. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 to close out the last full chapter of the story. After this only the final mission stands between you and the post-story free roam where the 100% checklist opens. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the only gold story trophy and it unlocks free roam afterwards, when the 100% Completion Checklist becomes visible (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); Push Square on the post-story checklist.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Push Square

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Story mission trophies pop on completion, so play the mission through and it is yours. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a heist, so expect a big set-piece: follow the mission objectives and the trophy pops at the end. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies it is awarded for finishing the mission, nothing more. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy happens, so remember the layout for later. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named story-mission trophies; finish it and the story set is complete. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which only opens after the story ends (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). Per Shacknews (source: Rockstar Games) it asks for 100 story completion, 100 optional tasks, 70 of the 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone time trials, 30 unique races won, 15 meditation spots, 100 Cocaine Flamingos and more. It is the longest grind in the game — leave it for last and let the other trophies feed it. Source: Shacknews 100% checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and the like. Stunts count toward the 100% checklist too, which asks for 300, so keep doing them past 250. Find stunt spots on the map (Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots) and track your total under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. Source: Push Square (stunt spots and tracking); Shacknews for the 300-stunt 100% figure.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the 9 activity types in the game — the list's own count, confirmed by Push Square. Use the Activities tab (Touch Pad, then Activities) to see what exists and tick each type off once; you do not need to master any of them. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles) for the 9 types; Push Square.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Push Square

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Push Square names two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; find them on the map under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges, and track progress the same way. Gold each challenge's target score — bring your best pistol and rifle skills, and redo the ones you silver until they turn gold. Source: Push Square (42 challenges, two ranges, tracking); GTA6 Database (42 challenges across the ranges).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. GTA6 Database counts 42 drone time trials across those 14 spots, and every one counts toward 100% completion, so winning each location's race also feeds A Long Road. Learn each course's line first with a slow run, then push for the win. Source: GTA6 Database (14 locations, 42 trials); Push Square.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so vary the events instead of repeating one you like. The 100% checklist asks for 30 unique races won, so keep racing past 20 and this trophy feeds the gold. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); Shacknews for the 30-race 100% figure.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also ticks Master of None if you have not tried fishing yet. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine and play one game through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand until his final mission, then complete it. Side-character strands unlock as you meet the character in free roam and the story advances; check the map for Andy's marker when it appears. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame lists this among the hidden side trophies.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. These side strands are found in free roam, so sweep the map for Kenton's marker between story beats. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand with his final mission. Like the other side-character finals, it is a hidden trophy that pops when the strand's last mission ends. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full Strangers & Freaks-style mission strands scattered across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands in the game — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's strands all count — so finish any 8 and the silver pops. Hunt for stranger markers on the map in every region, not just Vice City. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); Push Square.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; Push Square

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Watch for Randy's marker in free roam and work the strand between story missions. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. It is one of the five named side-character finals, all hidden trophies. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: GTABase and PowerPyx both flag it, and KeenGamer names the spot — after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating at Jason's house in the morning; follow her to the balcony and accept, and finish that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1. The other spots can be done any time; track them under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations, and on the map under Exploration, then Meditate Around Leonida. Source: Push Square (18 spots, tracking); KeenGamer (Chapter 1 balcony warning).
trophies.missable_note: The only trophy flagged as possibly missable (GTABase, PowerPyx): one meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony and meditate there before leaving Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Push Square (18 spots); KeenGamer (Chapter 1 warning); GTABase / PowerPyx via EGamers.io

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting work and track down the unique animal he wants. Hunting is one of the side activities, so bring a scoped rifle, move quietly, and follow the animal's trail rather than charging in. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame lists this among the hidden side trophies.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Finish 3 complete collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; the 100% checklist counts 15 complete sets in total, so there are far more cards than this trophy needs — collect any 3 sets and the silver pops. Pick up every card you pass while doing other things and the sets will build themselves. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); KeenGamer (15 sets for 100%).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan at 100 different locations around Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app — open it at marked spots and let it register each one; the count is tracked for you, so work through the map region by region. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame (WAiNK scans guide).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges are small in-game feats across combat, driving and exploration — browse them under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Challenges, and pick the easiest 50 first. The 100% checklist wants 70, so keep going after this pops. Source: Push Square (80 challenges, 50 needed, tracking); Shacknews (70 for 100%).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Bring your partner along (character switching lets you play as both), cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat dies. It is a setup trophy, not a missable one — you can retry it any time in free roam. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame (needs both characters together).
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. Plan a route of 3 close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving. Like Hot Together it needs both characters out together and is retryable in free roam. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Find and discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida — driving or entering a new model counts it. The game tracks discoveries for you; vary the cars you steal and drive, visit different districts, and the count climbs on its own. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus (the slow-motion aiming mode) and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang shootout or a police standoff — enter focus with a full magazine, and chain the five kills in one activation. Retryable any time. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame (Combat Focus guide).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — the trophy's own wording hints at stealing a plane and taking off without a flight plan. Head to VCIA, get a plane airborne by any means, and the trophy pops. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame lists it among the hidden trophies.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The Rhinos are the game's tanks — this trophy is about surviving or causing chaos in one. The description is deliberately vague (it is a hidden trophy), so expect it to pop from an extended encounter with a Rhino tank: steal one, or survive one's attention. Exact trigger still being confirmed by guide writers. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); KeenGamer (trigger unconfirmed).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean without ever being spotted. Go in quiet: case the store first, move when staff look away, and leave before any alarm. If you are detected, leave and try another store — it is retryable. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank jobs are bigger than shop robberies — plan the getaway before you go in, and count each clean escape toward the five. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cash and escape. Armored trucks patrol set routes — wait for one on a quiet stretch, block it, crack it open and lose the wanted level that follows. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every area of Leonida — the list's count is 52 areas. Drive the whole map, including the outskirts and islands, and the trophy pops when the last area registers. The in-game map tracks what you have seen, so sweep region by region in free roam. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles) for the 52-area count.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Gang operations are marked on the map in free roam — hit one per gang and the trophy pops when the last gang's operation is robbed. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles) for the 9-gang count.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. The description gives you the place outright — this is a quiet moment trophy, so do it when you are next on the beachfront. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame lists it among the hidden trophies.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's front window and out the other side — the classic GTA showroom smash. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up, build speed, and go through the glass. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame lists it among the hidden trophies.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game — follow through on every throw. Bowling is one of the side activities, so this also ticks Master of None if you have not tried it yet. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Do something with your partner that the public loves — the description is deliberately vague (hidden trophy) and the exact trigger is still being confirmed by guide writers. The likeliest reading is a viral social-media moment with Lucia or Jason: post partner content through the in-game phone and watch for the pop. Treat it as unconfirmed until a guide pins it down. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); KeenGamer (method unconfirmed).
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — the list tracks them, counting up to 500. Story and stranger missions regularly offer a choice; pick one every time and the count climbs across the playthrough. There is no wrong answer for the trophy, so choose what fits your run. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame (counts to 500); Xarmo (500-choice count).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list; HowToVideoGame; Xarmo

trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed on the second try — the name says it all. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by guide writers, but the plain reading is a retry: fail a challenge or activity, then clear it on your next attempt. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); KeenGamer (method unconfirmed).
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — this is the game's weird-random-event trophy. Roam Leonida, especially at night and off the beaten path, and the event will find you; guide writers list its unlock method as unconfirmed, so treat any strange encounter as progress. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); KeenGamer (method unconfirmed).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the window, and connect. Any quiet street works; expect the exact trigger to be pinned down by guides after launch. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); KeenGamer (precise method still being confirmed).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — heists, vaults and armored trucks — and your contacts wash them into clean cash over time. Keep robbing and keep laundering; the total is cumulative. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything. The total is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so buy what you need as you go and it will pop naturally; if you are short late on, stock up on ammo and outfits. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida — the list's count is 8 garages. Garages are bought from property markers on the map; save up through the story, then buy them in a sweep once you have the cash. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles) for the 8-garage count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game vehicle-sharing app. Drive a vehicle you own or find, open the app, and register it; repeat with 10 different vehicles. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); HowToVideoGame (Scooter Bros guide).
trophies.name: On the Spot
